paragraphs.text: Adds a whole-document copy button to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar editor header, right of Save
# dsh-copy-document
## Summary
The right sidebar's file editor shows a document one screen at a time; getting the whole thing into
another tool means selecting past the viewport or scrolling to load every page. This plugin adds one
control to that editor's header, immediately right of **Save**: it copies the document's entire tex
t to the clipboard in one click.
It reads through `dsh-better-sidebar`'s own `/sidebar/api/fs.read` route (and pages with `fs.readPag
e` above the editor's 5 MB threshold), so the session scope, the browser-trust fence, and the encodi
ng detection stay owned by that plugin.
## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness with the **`dsh-better-sidebar`** plugin mounted (the editor header this button j

oins belongs to it). Without that plugin there is no header and the button never appears.
- A secure
browser context for the async Clipboard API; any modern build of the Web GUI qualifies on `localhos
owser context for the async Clipboard API; any modern build of the Web GUI qualifies on `localhost`.
## Install
Install it from the repository into a profile, then restart the harness:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The repository commits its built `lib/`, so this install needs no build step and no `allowBuilds` en
try — pnpm fetches a package that is already runnable. An unpinned reference follows `main`; a later
`add` of a newer commit updates it.
From a local checkout — the path used during development:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Manual install (what that command does):
1. Add `"dsh-copy-document": "github:ionaryu/dsh-copy-document"` to the profile's `package.json` dep

endencies.
2. Append `"dsh-copy-document"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`.
3. Run `pnpm install` in the pr
ofile directory, then restart.
## What the button does
| State | Icon | Meaning |

| Idle | copy glyph | Copies the whole document on click |
| Working | — | The button is disabled wh

ile the read and clipboard write are in flight |
| Copied | check | The document's text is on the cl

ipboard (1.2 s) |
| Unavailable | warning | The document is binary — there is no text to copy |
| Fa
iled | warning | The read or the clipboard write failed; the console carries the reason |
The button is placed right of **Save**. Documents the editor shows read-only (above the 5 MB editabl
e threshold) have no Save control; there it sits right of **Refresh**, in the same group.
## Known limitations
- **The clipboard gets the file on disk, not the editor buffer.** An unsaved draft is not copied; sa

ve first (`Ctrl/Cmd+S`) and copy afterwards.
- **Binary documents have nothing to copy.** Images, PD

Fs, and office documents report *Not a text document*.
- **Placement is DOM-based.** `dsh-better-sid
ebar` exposes tab and file-viewer registration only, with no toolbar extension point, so this plugin
attaches to the rendered header (recognised by its path input and file-tree toggle) and re-attaches
after every re-render. A future release that changes that header's structure can drop the button; n

othing else in the editor is touched.
- **One active session.** The read is scoped to the sidebar's
active session, which is the session whose file the visible editor belongs to.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
pnpm 11 prints `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` for esbuild's install script. It is advisory: esbuild's pla
tform binary arrives as a regular optional dependency, and `pnpm run build` works without the script
. Run `pnpm approve-builds` and pick esbuild to clear it.
A `file:` install is a **copy** in the profile's `node_modules`, not a link: after rebuilding, run `
pnpm install` in the profile directory again (or `dsh plugin --profile web add file:/E:/dsh-plugins/
dsh-copy-document`), then restart the GUI. A running GUI keeps the bundles it booted with. A `github
:` install pins a commit, so rebuilding locally and pushing needs a fresh `add` to update the profil
all pins a commit, so rebuilding locally and pushing needs a fresh `add` to update the profile copy.
`lib/client.js` is wrapped in the client module system's registration protocol (`window.__ModuleLoad
er__.load({ id, factory })`) and imports nothing, so no module-table dependency is declared.
